post.caption: Taylor's Oscar tiara was a husband's idea. In 1957, producer Mike Todd gave Elizabeth Taylor an antique diamond tiara, telling her she was his queen and should have one. It dates from about 1880 and has nine diamond scrolls set in platinum and gold. She wore it to the 1957 Academy Awards, where Todd's film Around the World in 80 Days won Best Picture, and again at the Cannes Film Festival. In December 2011, Christie's sold it for more than four million dollars, and part of the money went to her AIDS foundation.
